predictions: Dropped another pick in a tiebreaker last week, along with a couple more 13-11s and a 14-10, so my quite decent 20-7 record for the week once again was so close to so much better. That brings me to 229-91 (71.6% correct) for the season, and I'm now at 0.500 or better with every team outside of F division. Sadly, I'm only at 0.500 or (barely) better with 3 of the 7 F teams, as I'm a sad 16-20 in that infernal mess.

Match of the week: (A Div.) The Inflationary Element @ Jonesing for Mugs. This one is simple. If Jonesing wins, they end the season as the RDL's top squad. If Element wins, they still have a big hurdle next week before claiming that top spot. There will be fireworks, huge shots, and some heartbreak in this superb matchup. Have to go Element, 13-11.

Match #2: (F Div.) Cheap Shots @ Death Throw. Down To F has won 6 in a row, but this is F, so if you think anything at all is a done deal, you're a fool. With the season points as they are, either of these teams could end up on top with a win in this critical showdown, despite both of them currently being on two-match slides. Cheap Shots, 13-11.

Match #3: (G Div.) We're Sexy & We Throw It @ Rippin Darts. Wow, G is still a four-team battle royale with so many possible outcomes. Last week's leader takes on this week's leader here, in a division that cycles leaders almost weekly lately. I'm guessing Rippin stays on top, 13-11.

Match #4: (E Div.) What's the Point? @ Runs with Corks. The Corks are the last potential challenger to Point's supremacy here in E, but with Point's giant win last week, that challenge is now honestly a small one. Clearly the premier pairing in E, but it's tough to go against Point. 14-10.

Match #5: (C Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ Darty Little Secrets. Area waltzed away with the C crown, but the other spot in the top pair is very much up for grabs. And this match likely decides it! Menace in 1001?

Match #6: (B Div.) Consistently Inconsistent @ The Kids who say "Ni!" The Kids can control their own title fates in week 14, but only if they handle business here. No small task, but they do…. barely. 13-11.
Match #7: (H Div.) Dirty Darts (Done Dirt Cheap) @ SofaKings. Sofa is suddenly just a win from clinching H. They can avoid any week 14 showdown drama of any kind with a win right here, 16-8.
Match #8: (A Div.) Wing & A Plaque @ Darty Minds. It's very likely that only Wing has a real shot at reeling in Beach for a top 4 finish. The problem is that I think Darty pays them back here, 14-10.
Match #9: (D Div.) Nine Lives @ Double In Stumble Out. There are four (or five?) D teams still waging a huge battle to determine who the bottom two will be. Well, it won't be the Niners. 14-10.
Match #10: (G Div.) Flight Club @ Aim-ing For Trouble. This is almost directly a head-to-head to see who is likely to drop to H in the spring. I'm thinking that Aim flips the script this time, 13-11.
Match #11: (E Div.) Outlaw Arrows @ Off Constantly-Reboot. If the Arrows can win their last two, they could abruptly climb from the cellar right out of the bottom-two altogether. Alas, OC, 13-11.

Match #12: (H Div.) Bright Side of Flights @ Calm Under Pressure. Could Calm's first win immediately become Calm's first win streak? I would love to say yes, but I think I have to go with Bright, 14-10.
And the remaining 15 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: Appetite for Destruction 18, Dart Attack 6.
B Division: Serious? 13, Possee 11; Angry Birds 15, OnlyDarts 10.
C Division: Mulligans Mafia 15, Still Hump'N 9; Projectile Dysfunct. 13, Brutha Ducks 11; Area 501 16, Pints and Points 8.
D Division: Darty Sanchez 14, The Bullies 10; Dart Knights 14, Shooter McGavin 10; Point & Rally 15, One Armed Bandits 9.
E Division: Heart of Dartness 13, Shooting Blanks 11.
F Division: Down To F 15, Shooters 9; Two Time 13, She Said 11.
G Division: Banging the Wire 16, Cary On Our Wayward Darts 8.
H Division: Double Vision 15, Rangers 9; The Blind 13, Afraid 11.

headlines.A: Jonesing drops Appetite again with a scorching 37-dart 1001 to take even more control of A race; Beach takes all sets from Darty in big step toward locking in top-4-in-RDL spot
headlines.B: Serious and Kids roll, now just one hurdle from a head-to-head title fight; Angry tops Inconsistent to move to 4th
headlines.C: Area becomes first to clinch a division this season, extending their unbeaten streak to 40 weeks (just 2 from RDL's 5th longest run ever); Ducks top Menace in 1001, making the race for 2nd wide open; Secrets and Mafia post important wins
headlines.D: Shorthanded Rally narrowly escapes McGavin; Knights roll past Bandits, likely clinching their top-two finish; Bullies sweep all doubles from Stumble to climb out of the cellar
headlines.E: What's the Point drops a statement win on Blanks, taking all 12 '01 pts; Off Constantly gets big 501 sweep in effort to avoid a bottom-two slot, likely ending Dartness's shot at 2nd
headlines.F: Down To F gets critical win over Cheapies; Death Throw falls in 1001 to Two Time to fall a match off the pace; Nein Mark escapes the Shooters in 1001 to keep hold of #4 spot
headlines.G: Machine's 5th straight win yanks We Throw It from G lead; Rippin and Banging both win, move into the #1/#2 slots
headlines.H: Let's goooooo!!! Calm Under Pressure's first ever RDL win comes over Double Vision, who was undefeated just two weeks ago; Sofa now within a single win of clinching H title
